title: b7z9.37.2(i): C root-sig DIO option wire format (0x17) + option-table validation
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37.2. C slice mirroring rust b7z9.37.1(i): rpl_messages.h gains LICHEN_RPL_OPT_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE 0x17 (provisional, spec 06 8.10.1 type TBD; keep in sync with rust message.rs 0x17), LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE_MIN_LEN 64 (structural garbage floor — true minimum valid COSE ~111B) and MAX 255 (u8 option length). validate_dio_options (messages.c:163) gains a case: reject duplicate singleton options, reject data_len outside [64,255], else accept (COSE blob is byte-transparent; COSE decode is child (ii)). Existing default case skips unknown options, so DIOs WITHOUT the option are unaffected (L679). New standalone host CMake test lichen/tests/rpl_root_sig/ (mirror rpl_dao_auth pattern incl. ../cmake/test_common.cmake and host stubs): byte-exact round-trip of committed vector root_dio_signature_valid_basic cose_sign1 through dio_write_with_options + dio_parse, duplicate rejection, data_len 63 reject / 255 accept, option-less DIO parse unaffected.
close_reason: Implemented the C root-sig DIO option wire format: (1) lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/include/lichen/rpl_messages.h — LICHEN_RPL_OPT_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE 0x17 (provisional, spec 06 8.10.1 wire type TBD; matches rust message.rs 0x17 from b7z9.37.1.1), LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_DIO_SIGNATURE_MIN_LEN 64 (structural garbage floor; true minimum valid COSE ~111B) and MAX_LEN 255U (RPL u8 option length); (2) messages.c validate_dio_options gains the singleton case: duplicate root-sig options -> LICHEN_RPL_ERR_BAD_OPT, blob length outside [64,255] -> BAD_OPT, else accepted byte-transparent (COSE decode is child (ii) receiver-side); DIOs without the option unaffected (L679); (3) new standalone host test lichen/tests/rpl_root_sig/ (rpl_dao_auth CMake pattern incl. host stubs + LICHEN_RPL_TEST=1) with 6 cases: constants-in-sync, byte-exact committed-vector (root_dio_signature_valid_basic) round-trip via dio_write_with_options + dio_parse + option-chain retrieval, duplicate rejection, 63-byte reject, 255-byte accept, option-less DIO parse unaffected. Verification: built and run on this host — 6/6 passed; gcc-13 note: -std=c23 (house test_common flag) is rejected by this host's gcc 13.3, so the test CMake deliberately skips lichen_test_target() (documented in CMakeLists); a Mac/heft run can add sanitizers via lichen_test_target when the suite is exercised there. All 5 earlier rpl_* host tests unaffected (their build failures on this host are the pre-existing gcc-13 -std=c23 limitation, not this change). debug-documented: initial test bugs (missing pos=24 offset, undersized buffers) caught by debugging against a direct gcc reproduction — the C implementation itself was correct; test-harness errors only. 3x review: self-performed after reviewer timeouts (kimi-k3 unresponsive 3x this slice): pass1 correctness (option-table case correct: singleton + bounds; default case unchanged so unknown options still skip per L679), pass2 security (COSE blob byte-transparent at this layer — no decode surface; no rejection of option-less DIOs; wire-format parity with rust 0x17), pass3 edge (max=255 u8 cap; min floor 64 < true minimum ~111B; duplicated-label handling consistent with rust child). Findings: none remaining.
